//history_path: MUST be overridden by KPI_HISTORY_PATH with an s3://bucket/key URI. /var/task is read-only and the filesystem does not survive an invocation, so a local path means the collapse guardrail never gets a baseline and a retry posts the report twice. lambda_handler refuses to run without it.
